objective: Build a system for managing library books, students, borrowing, and returns.

actors.name: Librarian
actors.description: Manages books, users, borrowing, and reports.

functional_requirements.description: Users can register and log in.
Students can search and view available books.
Students can borrow and return books.
Librarians can add, update, and remove books.

non_functional_requirements.description: 95% of requests should complete within 2 seconds.

constraints: The system should support role-based access control.
assumptions: The initial deployment is for a single college campus.
